name: IntegrateIT UniFi Network
notes: Watch a UniFi Network deployment from Control4 over Ubiquiti's official local Integration API (X-API-KEY, HTTPS): controller reachability and version, site device counts with online/offline health events, named-client presence (up to three watched clients with Came Online / Went Offline events), and one guarded control action — power-cycling a PoE switch port to reboot a stuck camera, AP, or doorbell. LAN-only destination safeguard, the API key never logged, and MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
